target.title: fix(gateway-client): recover unbounded requests after missed ticks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a gateway client waiting for a final result could stop receiving server ticks indefinitely without reconnecting. The pending `expectFinal` request suppressed the tick watchdog even though it had no request timeout.

## Why This Change Was Made

The tick watchdog continues to defer to requests that have their own finite timeout. Requests that are intentionally unbounded, including `expectFinal`, no longer mask a dead connection; missing ticks close the socket so the normal reconnect path can restore liveness.

## User Impact

Long-running session and chat operations keep working normally while ticks arrive. If a gateway connection becomes unresponsive, clients recover instead of waiting indefinitely for a final result that can no longer arrive.

## Evidence

- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway-client.config.ts packages/gateway-client/src/client.watchdog.test.ts` — 17 tests passed.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check`, `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs`, and `git diff --check` passed for the changed files.
- Final `autoreview --mode local --engine codex --thinking high` reported no actionable findings.
- Remote Testbox proof could not run because this environment is not authenticated to the `openclaw` organization; GitHub CI remains the remote validation path.

AI-assisted implementation and review.
